preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
For each test case, k must be even and within the range of 2 to n, where n is the length of the string.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in '01?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have a length equal to n and consist only of characters '0', '1', and '?'.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any(c in '01' for c in s) or all(c == '?' for c in s)
postconditions.description: If the string s contains at least one '0' or '1', it must be possible to replace '?' to achieve a k-balanced bitstring.

postconditions.expression: all(s[i:i+k].count('0') == s[i:i+k].count('1') for i in range(n - k + 1))
postconditions.description: After replacing '?', every substring of length k must have an equal number of '0's and '1's.
